candidates.change_summary: Replace the unlockTime assignment so it always uses block.timestamp, ignoring the _unlockTime argument.
Change the overflow check to always revert by replacing >= with <.
Delete the balance increment statement so the stored balance never increases.
Insert `acc.balance = 0;` after the balance increment, resetting balance to zero after every deposit.
Remove the block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime check to allow collection regardless of unlock time.
Change subtract to add in the balance update, increasing balance instead of decreasing it.
Change the transfer amount from _am to zero, so balance decreases but Ether is not sent.
Remove the acc.balance >= _am check, allowing collection greater than the balance.
Remove the acc.balance >= MinSum check, allowing collection below the minimum sum threshold.
Change the subtraction to fail underflow-safe (Solidity 0.8) if _am > acc.balance, by changing subtraction to assignment of zero.
Delete the entire if condition body so Collect does nothing even though the function is called successfully.
Move the balance subtraction after the external call, leaving balance unchanged if the call reverts but breaking state if it succeeds.
